ev.q: Pixel Piracy is an open world and side-scrolling action-adventure game
praise going to its sandbox elements
players construct a pirate ship, hire and train a crew
the player must manage the crew's hunger and deal with equipment requirements
can upgrade their ship with cannons
the game also has permadeath, which means that the captain does not respawn after death
describing the controls as complicated, and the combat system as perplexing
described the design of the islands as "repetitive"
Reviewers praised the game's soundtrack, especially the use of sea shanties
